title: MERGE NOTES: ask.py output shape is NOT backward compatible
evidence: PR-JUDGEMENT-REVIEW.html, PR#23. result.matches replaces top-level matches. CLI flags compatible, OUTPUT is not.

spec.description: Any caller parsing the old JSON breaks SILENTLY - no error, just a missing key. This belongs in the MERGE NOTES where a merger will see it, not buried in a handoff document nobody reads at merge time.
spec.context: The distinction matters: CLI flag compatibility is often mistaken for interface compatibility, and here the flags are compatible while the output contract changed. A silent break is worse than a loud one because nothing signals it at merge. Cold independent review 2026-08-07, reviewer did not author either PR, read-only.
